pattern: Free care when household income is at or under 200% of the poverty level
note: Matches both policy versions. Verified income, decision-year poverty table.

pattern: Discount above 200% up to 400%: patient pays 30% of the patient balance
note: Adjustment is 70% of patient_responsibility, rounded to the cent.

pattern: Denied as over income above 400%, interest-free payment plan offered
note: Outcome is a payment plan, not a write-off.

pattern: Medi-Cal enrollees get free care without income documents
Homeless patients get free care without income documents
note: income_proof NONE, homeless Y, HOMELESS or shelter address.

pattern: Applications denied as late (over 240 days after the first bill)
note: AB 2297: no application deadline from 2025-01-01, even while the old policy was in effect.
AB 2297: savings and other monetary assets can't be counted from 2025-01-01.

pattern: Applications denied for no pay stubs when other proof was on file
note: AB 2297: other proof of income must be accepted from 2025-01-01.

pattern: An approval covers every visit in the 12 months from the decision date
note: Later visits inside the 12 months were written off under the earlier approval.

pattern: Payment plans: 12 equal monthly payments rounded up to the dollar, at least $25, no interest
note: Fewer months only when $25 a month pays it off sooner.

pattern: CalFresh enrollees handled inconsistently (some approved free without income documents, others left in needs info or closed)
note: No written rule in either policy version. A counselor's correction can turn it into one.
